response.quote_a: Headmaster Gr.II / Teachers who have completed a minimum period of two years-service in a School as on 30 th April of the year, in which transfers are to be taken up, shall be eligible to apply for transfer.
response.quote_b: Teachers who have completed one year of service in the present school are eligible to apply for transfer.
response.explanation: Document A requires a minimum of two years of service in a school to be eligible for transfer, whereas Document B states that teachers who have completed one year of service are eligible.
